title: Pascal interface references form cycles unless one side is declared [weak]
notes:
Mobile-Delphi added [weak] / [unsafe] precisely to handle this
case. Pre-XE5 code does NOT use them and leaks silently. The
migration target chooses: rely on .NET / Java GC (no problem),
or preserve the explicit-ownership model with WeakReference. The
open question captures which choice the SME wants. Calibrated
against real Delphi/Indy listener-registration patterns where
the handler holds a back-reference to the component.
